edges.why: manual secure code review requires a human reviewer
DAST requires a running deployed service and a scanning tool (e.g. OWASP ZAP) that is not installed
IAST requires runtime instrumentation agent support from the language runtime
manual penetration testing requires a human tester; PREFLIGHT PF-017 human lane
automated penetration testing needs a deployed target and a DAST tool such as OWASP ZAP, which is not installed
red team testing requires a human team and a deployed environment
purple team testing requires both offensive and defensive human participants
adversary emulation requires a human red team and a deployed environment
breach and attack simulation requires a deployed production-like environment
mutation-based fuzzing requires a coverage-guided fuzzer (cargo-fuzz/AFL), not installed
artifact signing verification requires a code-signing certificate (REQ-036 external gate)
binary analysis requires Ghidra or IDA Pro, which are not installed
reverse engineering analysis requires a disassembler toolchain, not installed
pre-deployment testing requires a deployment target; AUTO_DEPLOY is false
security test orchestration requires a CI runner; the local harness covers this
Common Criteria evaluation is an external laboratory certification, not an in-repo test
clean-room deployment verification requires a disposable environment with no local caches (PREFLIGHT PF-014)
version-skew testing requires a second released version; only one candidate exists
downgrade and rollback compatibility requires a prior released version
soak testing requires an extended wall-clock budget beyond a single verification run
user acceptance testing requires human participants; PREFLIGHT PF-017 human lane
reproducible-build verification requires a second clean environment to compare digests (PREFLIGHT PF-014)
upgrade-path verification requires a prior released version to upgrade from
visual regression requires approved baseline screenshots from a human-reviewed run
deployment, promotion and canary lifecycle requires a deployment target; AUTO_DEPLOY is false
assistive-technology validation requires a human using Narrator or NVDA; PREFLIGHT PF-017
